> Canvex Studio is a New York-based independent web design and development studio founded by Dillan Darcheville. The studio creates cinematic digital experiences, high-end UI design, and production-grade web development for brands globally.

## Identity

- **Studio name:** Canvex Studio

- **Email:** canvexstudio@gmail.com

## About

Canvex Studio is a full-service creative and engineering studio. Founded by Dillan Darcheville, the studio designs and builds digital products that combine cinematic aesthetics with engineering precision. Clients work directly with the founder — no account managers, no handoffs. Projects are delivered within approximately 2 weeks from kickoff to launch.

## Services

- **Creative Direction** — Visual identity, brand strategy, mood direction, and narrative design for digital products.
- **Interface Design** — High-fidelity UI design systems, component libraries, and interaction design built for production.
- **Web Development** — Full-stack web development using React, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Vite. Sites are fast, accessible, and SEO-optimized.
- **Experience Design** — User journey mapping, conversion rate optimization, and UX audits.

## Technologies

React, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Vite, Shopify, Contentful, Sanity, Supabase, Stripe, AWS, Vercel, Netlify.

## Pricing

- Landing page / portfolio site: from $2,500
- Full brand + web build: $5,000 – $15,000+
- All engagements begin with a free 30-minute discovery call.

## Common Questions

**Q: How much does a web design project cost?**
A: A landing page or portfolio site starts at $2,500. Full brand and web builds range from $5,000 to $15,000+. Every engagement starts with a free 30-minute discovery call.

**Q: How long does a project take?**
A: Most projects are delivered in approximately 2 weeks from kickoff to launch.

**Q: Does Canvex Studio work with clients outside New York?**
A: Yes. While based in New York, Canvex Studio serves clients globally via fully remote collaboration.

**Q: What makes Canvex Studio different from other web design agencies?**
A: Direct founder access (Dillan Darcheville), cinematic design quality, production-grade engineering, and a 2-week delivery window. No account managers. No handoffs.

**Q: What technologies does Canvex Studio use?**
A: Primarily React, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Vite. Shopify for e-commerce. Contentful or Sanity for CMS. Deployed on Vercel or Netlify.

**Q: Can Canvex Studio redesign an existing website?**
A: Yes. The studio audits current sites for performance, conversion, and brand alignment, then rebuilds with a clear strategy.

## Key Facts

- Canvex Studio is NOT a large agency — clients work directly with the founder.
- Average project delivery: 2 weeks.
- Global clientele. Based in New York, NY.
- Design philosophy: technology should feel invisible; the experience should feel unforgettable.
- 100% client satisfaction rate.
